claims: LeBron James has two sons, Bronny James and Bryce James.
Bronny James is a rookie guard for the Los Angeles Lakers.
Bronny James is LeBron James Jr.
Bronny James was selected 55th overall in the 2024 NBA Draft out of USC.
In March 2026, Bronny James and LeBron James became the first father-son duo to play in the NBA at the same time.
In March 2026, Bronny James and LeBron James recorded a "father-son assist".
Bronny James suffered a cardiac arrest in July 2023 due to a congenital heart defect.
Bronny James successfully returned to basketball after suffering a cardiac arrest in July 2023.
Bryce James is committed to playing college basketball for the Arizona Wildcats.
Bryce James is a freshman for the Arizona Wildcats as of January 2026
